name: tribe
description: A tribe of collaborating agents for product delivery, bound by a strict chain of command: Owner ⇄ Shaman ⇄ Warchief ⇄ Hunter — a role speaks only to its adjacent ranks. The Shaman is the owner's delegate and the single entry point for all work: it answers What & Why (never How), co-creates the roadmap with the owner, then runs the campaign — dispatching the Warchief one idea card at a time, ruling on its NEEDS_DIRECTION questions, escalating only the irreversible few to the owner, and verifying SHIPPED outcomes against each card's measurable goal. The Warchief answers How — spec + bite-sized TDD plan, orchestrates Hunters, audits with the adversarial-reviewer, lands a green squash-merged PR with before/after evidence, never writing feature source and never contacting the owner. The Hunter is the implementer — one task at a time under strict TDD, reporting only to the Warchief. Decisions flow down as idea cards and briefs; questions flow up as statuses (NEEDS_DIRECTION / NEEDS_CONTEXT / BLOCKED); code flows only from the Hunter; memory lives in files (roadmap + Decision Log, spec, plan, report files).
